name: VNDegen
subtitle: Visual novels and RPG Maker games, native on iPhone and iPad.
description: VNDegen runs visual novel and RPG Maker games natively. Copy a game's folder into the Games folder in the Files app, or import a zip, RAR, or 7z archive, and VNDegen detects its engine and shows it in a game hub with artwork from Steam, SteamGridDB, IGDB, and VNDB. Supports touch, controllers, and keyboard, hidden games behind Face ID or a passcode, and Ludusavi save backups.

versions.localizedDescription:
Adds TyranoScript, the second engine.

## Downloads

- `VNDegen-0.2.0.ipa` for iPhone and iPad (iOS 18 or later). Update it from the AltStore or SideStore source (`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChronoStriker1/vndegen/main/altstore/source.json`), or sideload it with Sideloadly.
- `VNDegen-0.2.0-macOS.zip` for Mac (macOS 15 or later). It is ad-hoc signed: right-click VNDegen and choose Open the first time, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/VNDegen.app`.

## New

- TyranoScript and TyranoBuilder games: plain browser builds, NW.js builds, and Electron builds, including games packed in `app.asar`. Tested with three games covering Tyrano 4.50 and 5.20, Japanese text, and a controller from title screen through choices, saving, and loading.
- Saves stay in the game folder as on PC. Games that save to browser storage keep it per game inside VNDegen.
- Ogg audio plays on iPhone and iPad: VNDegen converts each track to AAC the first time it plays and caches it.

## Fixed

- Archive import keeps every part of a split archive safe from cleanup while it is open, and follows an archive that moved during import.
- A security fix for how game files are opened, so a game folder cannot read files outside itself through a symlink.

## Known limits

- Typing a name in a game with a controller does not bring up the keyboard; use touch or a hardware keyboard.
- Ogg files that use Opus instead of Vorbis may play silent.
- In some TyranoScript games, VNDegen's menu button sits over the game's own button in the top right corner.
- The Hidden games and Metadata sources settings pages still need touch or a mouse.

Safety fixes for importing archives.

## Downloads

- `VNDegen-0.1.4.ipa` for iPhone and iPad (iOS 18 or later). Update it from the AltStore or SideStore source (`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChronoStriker1/vndegen/main/altstore/source.json`), or sideload it with Sideloadly.
- `VNDegen-0.1.4-macOS.zip` for Mac (macOS 15 or later). It is ad-hoc signed: right-click VNDegen and choose Open the first time, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/VNDegen.app`.

## Fixed

- "Delete archive after import" now deletes an archive only if it is still the same file VNDegen imported. If you replace it in Files during an import, the new file is kept and the result screen says so.
- Copies delivered through Open in VNDegen are no longer cleaned up while an import is still reading them or before VNDegen has received them.
- Split archives with the same name in different formats (for example `Game.zip.001` and `Game.7z.001`) are listed as separate archives, and two files for the same part are refused with a clear message.

## Known limits

- Only RPG Maker MV and MZ games run so far.
- The Hidden games and Metadata sources settings pages still need touch or a mouse.

Makes adding games work on installs where iOS will not hand picked files to VNDegen.

## Downloads

- `VNDegen-0.1.3.ipa` for iPhone and iPad (iOS 18 or later). Update it from the AltStore or SideStore source (`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChronoStriker1/vndegen/main/altstore/source.json`), or sideload it with Sideloadly.
- `VNDegen-0.1.3-macOS.zip` for Mac (macOS 15 or later). It is ad-hoc signed: right-click VNDegen and choose Open the first time, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/VNDegen.app`.

## New

- Ready to import: copy a zip, RAR, or 7z into VNDegen's folder in the Files app (On My iPhone, VNDegen, or its Games folder), and the library lists it with an Import button. This needs no file picker, so it works even when Choose Archive does nothing. "Delete archive after import" starts on for these, since the archive was copied there only to import it.

## Fixed

- On some sideloaded installs, iOS refuses to give VNDegen access to a file picked in Choose Archive, opened with Open in VNDegen, or dropped from Files (the iPhone log shows `Could not resolve bookmark ... Cocoa 257`). Those paths could look like they do nothing. Ready to import avoids them.
- Archives are read under file coordination, so a cloud provider cannot move or replace one mid-import.
- Opening a second archive while the first is still being read no longer disturbs either one, and late or rejected drops no longer leave copies behind.
- Copies that arrive through Open in VNDegen are treated as copies: no delete toggle, and they are removed afterwards.

## Known limits

- Only RPG Maker MV and MZ games run so far.
- The Hidden games and Metadata sources settings pages still need touch or a mouse.

Fixes for adding games from archives on iPhone and iPad.

## Downloads

- `VNDegen-0.1.2.ipa` for iPhone and iPad (iOS 18 or later). Update it from the AltStore or SideStore source (`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChronoStriker1/vndegen/main/altstore/source.json`), or sideload it with Sideloadly.
- `VNDegen-0.1.2-macOS.zip` for Mac (macOS 15 or later). It is ad-hoc signed: right-click VNDegen and choose Open the first time, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/VNDegen.app`.

## Fixed

- Choose Archive on iPhone and iPad now uses the system file picker the way Apple presents it. Before, picking a file and tapping Open could do nothing.
- Dragging a zip, RAR, or 7z from the Files app onto VNDegen now works on iPhone and iPad, on the import screen and on the library.

## New

- Open in VNDegen: in Files, tap an archive, then Share, then VNDegen, and the import screen opens with it. On a Mac, use Open With.

## If adding a game still fails

VNDegen now logs every file picker result. Connect the iPhone to a Mac, open Console, select the iPhone, search for `archiveimport`, then try again. The log line shows whether the picker handed the file to VNDegen.

## Known limits

- Only RPG Maker MV and MZ games run so far.
- The Hidden games and Metadata sources settings pages still need touch or a mouse.

Fixes from the independent code review. No new features.

## Downloads

- `VNDegen-0.1.1.ipa` for iPhone and iPad (iOS 18 or later). Install or update it from the AltStore or SideStore source (`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChronoStriker1/vndegen/main/altstore/source.json`), or sideload it with Sideloadly.
- `VNDegen-0.1.1-macOS.zip` for Mac (macOS 15 or later). It is ad-hoc signed: right-click VNDegen and choose Open the first time, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/VNDegen.app`.

## Fixed

- "Delete archive after import" is offered only for archives stored inside VNDegen itself, so it can no longer remove the original of a file synced by iCloud, Dropbox, or OneDrive.
- Archive import enforces size and free-space limits while it writes, rejects archives that declare impossible sizes, and no longer crashes on a malformed multi-part RAR name.
- Cancelling at the very end of an import can no longer finish it or delete the archive.
- On Mac, quitting mid-game always completes within about 20 seconds, even if a save backup hangs.
- A controller can now reach the folder name and password fields when importing, and focus no longer lands on a hidden row in the Ludusavi folder picker.

## Known limits

- Only RPG Maker MV and MZ games run so far.
- The Hidden games and Metadata sources settings pages still need touch or a mouse.

First test build. RPG Maker MV and MZ games run on Mac, iPhone, and iPad, verified with No Socks RPG.

## Downloads

- `VNDegen-0.1.0.ipa` for iPhone and iPad (iOS 18 or later). It is unsigned. Install it with Sideloadly or AltStore, which sign it with your Apple ID. A free Apple ID signature lasts 7 days.
- `VNDegen-0.1.0-macOS.zip` for Mac (macOS 15 or later). It is ad-hoc signed, so macOS blocks it on first open. Unzip it, move `VNDegen.app` to Applications, then right-click it and choose Open, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/VNDegen.app`.
- `SHA256SUMS` lists the checksums.

## What works

- RPG Maker MV and MZ games, unmodified, with saves in the same `.rmmzsave` format as the PC version. Encrypted assets, WebM movies, and Effekseer effects play.
- The library hub with artwork and metadata from Steam, SteamGridDB, IGDB, and VNDB, and per-device layouts for iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad, and Mac.
- Touch, mouse and keyboard, and game controllers. A controller drives the library, game pages, and their sheets. The Hidden games and Metadata sources settings pages still need touch or a mouse. On iPhone and iPad, an on-screen gamepad or virtual mouse appears when no controller is connected.
- Hidden games behind Face ID, Touch ID, or a passcode.
- In-game orientation lock: landscape by default on iPhone, and on iPad only when the app is full screen.
- Ludusavi backup and restore against an existing Ludusavi folder, including a network share connected in the Files app.
- Importing games from zip, RAR, and 7z archives with Add game.

## Adding games

- iPhone and iPad: Files, On My iPhone (or iPad), VNDegen, Games, one folder per game. Or use Add game with an archive.
- Mac: `~/Games/VNDegen`, one folder per game.

## Known limits

- Only RPG Maker MV and MZ games run so far. Other engines show as unsupported.
- Not yet tested on a physical iPhone, iPad, or controller.
- Password-protected RAR and 7z archives cannot be imported. Password-protected zips can.
- "Delete archive after import" may delete the original of a file synced by Dropbox or OneDrive. Leave it off for synced files. Fixed in the next release.
